name: L12 · 这里比北京冷多了
titleEn: It's much colder here than in Beijing

intro.cn: 在房间，王一雪接到白家月的电话。
intro.en: In the room, Wang Yixue was receiving a call from Bai Jiayue.

questions.q: 白家月今天什么时候有课？

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 喂，家月，是你啊！有什么事情吗？
lines.en: Hello, Jiayue, it's you! Is there anything you need?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 没什么事，就想跟您说说话。
lines.en: Nothing important. I just want to talk to you.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 好啊。你今天没课吗？
lines.en: Alright. Don't you have class today?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 下午有课。您那里天气怎么样？
lines.en: The class is in the afternoon. How's the weather in your place?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 北京这几天虽然是晴天，但是有点儿冷。
lines.en: Although it's sunny in Beijing these days, it's a bit cold.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 我这里比北京冷多了，外边还正下着雪呢！
lines.en: It's much colder here than in Beijing, and it's snowing outside right now!

postQuestions.q: 白家月那里的天气怎么样？

words.en: indicating an action just happening or a state just continuing

intro.cn: 在客厅，王一雪给王一飞打电话。
intro.en: In the living room, Wang Yixue was making a call to Wang Yifei.

questions.q: 王一飞那里的天气怎么样？
王一飞现在要去做什么？

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 喂，一飞，听家月说你那边下雪了，下得大不大？
lines.en: Hello, Yifei! I heard from Jiayue that it was snowing over there. Is it heavy?

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 今天不大，昨天比今天下得大。
lines.en: Not heavy today. Yesterday's snow was heavier than today's.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 天气不好，你去外面的时候多穿点儿衣服。
lines.en: The weather isn't good. Wear more clothes when you go outside.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 这几天我在网上上课，没出去过。
lines.en: I've been teaching online these days, so I haven't gone out.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 那就好，有事记得给我打电话。
lines.en: Alright, call me if you need any help.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 好的。现在不下雪了，我出去买点儿吃的。
lines.en: Alright. It's not snowing now, so I'll go out to buy some food.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 一次多买点儿，阴天下雪什么的就少出去吧。
lines.en: Buy more at once, and try to go out less when it's cloudy or snowy.

postQuestions.q: 王一飞这几天怎么给学生们上课？
王一雪为什么让王一飞多买点儿吃的？

intro.cn: 在房间，李文给白家月打电话。
intro.en: In the room, Li Wen was making a call to Bai Jiayue.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 喂，家月，今天天气不错，我们去跑步吧！
lines.en: Hello, Jiayue! The weather is nice today. Let's go for a run!

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 你跑步跑得比我快，我们能一起跑吗？
lines.en: You run faster than me. Can we run together?

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 可以的，我慢慢跑，等着你。
lines.en: It's OK. I'll run slowly and wait for you.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 好吧。你真爱跑步啊！
lines.en: Alright. You really love running!

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 我从小就经常跟爸爸跑步，跑步能让人快乐！
lines.en: I've been running with my dad since I was a child. Running makes people happy!

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 好，那我准备一下。
lines.en: Okay, I'll get ready.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 我现在坐地铁去找你，一会儿楼下见。
lines.en: I'm taking the subway to meet you now. See you downstairs in a bit.

postQuestions.q: 李文是从什么时候开始跑步的？
李文和白家月在哪儿见？

title.en: Writing a diary in the room

intro.cn: 在房间，白家月在写日记。
intro.en: In the room, Bai Jiayue was writing in her diary.

questions.q: 判断正误：今天是个晴天，白家月去外面跑步了。
判断正误：白家月很喜欢跟李文一起跑步。

lines.cn: 前几天天气不好，我没走路，每天坐两站地铁去学校。
lines.en: The weather had been bad over the past few days, so I didn't walk to school; I took the subway for two stops to school every day.

lines.cn: 今天是个大晴天，李文让我跟他去外面跑步。他小时候经常跑步，跑得比我快，但是他会等我。
lines.en: Today was a sunny day, and Li Wen asked me to go running outside with him. He often ran when he was a child. He ran faster than me, but he waited for me.

lines.cn: 跟李文一起跑步，我好高兴啊！
lines.en: Running with Li Wen made me so happy!

grammar.note: 用“比”表示的比较句中，“多了”或“得多”用在形容词后面，表示差别很大。基本结构：A 比 B＋形容词＋多了/得多。
grammar.noteEn: In comparative sentences with “比”, “多了” or “得多” is placed after the adjective to indicate a significant difference. Basic structure: A 比 B + Adjective + 多了/得多.

items.en: It's much colder here than in Beijing.

items.c: 坐飞机比坐火车快得多。
items.en: Taking a plane is much faster than taking a train.

items.c: 他觉得红茶比绿茶好喝得多。
items.en: He thinks black tea tastes much better than green tea.

practice.cn: A：左边这块手表好看还是右边那块好看？ B：左边这块，但是它____。
A：走，我请你喝咖啡。 B：喝奶茶吧，奶茶店____。我有点儿累，不想走太远。
A：几年没见你女儿了，她个子很高了吧？ B：是啊，个子____

grammar.note: 用“比”表示的比较句中，如果动词带状态补语，“比”用在动词前后都可以。
grammar.noteEn: In comparative sentences with “比”, if the verb is followed by a complement of state, “比” can be placed either before or after the verb.

items.en: Yesterday's snow was heavier than today's.
Mom goes to bed later than I do.
Li Wen runs faster than Bai Jiayue.

practice.cn: A：家月，你今天来得真早！ B：老师，天中____，他去外面跑步了。
A：小明，你中午没吃饭吧？晚上吃得这么多！ B：多吗？您看看姐姐，她____
A：一飞，这些汉字是外国人写的吗？ B：是啊！ A：真好看！我觉得____

grammar.note: 用“比”表示的比较句中，如果动词既带宾语，又带状态补语，可以把宾语提前，或者重复动词。如果动词是离合词，需要重复动词性语素。
grammar.noteEn: In comparative sentences with “比”, if the verb takes both an object and a complement of state, the object can be moved to the beginning of the sentence or the verb can be repeated. If the verb is a separable word, the verbal morpheme needs to be repeated.

items.c: 白家月汉字写得比陈天中好。
items.en: Bai Jiayue writes Chinese characters better than Chen Tianzhong.
He plays soccer better than I do.

A：你唱歌唱得怎么样？ B：还可以，但家月____

tips.note: “大晴天”的意思是天气很晴朗。
tips.noteEn: The term “大晴天” means the weather is very sunny.

items.cn: 你看，前边的那个人____高啊！
今天的天气没有昨天好，____正下着雨呢。
对不起，公司这几天____很多，太忙了，所以忘了你的生日。
A：我____就爱动，经常跟朋友一起踢球、跑步。 B：所以你身体这么好！
A：小雪在做什么呢？ B：快要考试了，她____看书呢。

classroomActivity.description: 两人一组，打电话谈论天气情况，并对比不同地方的天气差异，等等。尽可能使用本课所学生词和语法。
classroomActivity.descriptionEn: Work in pairs. Make a phone call to talk about the weather conditions, compare the weather in different places, and so on. Try to use the vocabulary and grammar learned in this lesson as much as possible.
